description: For a paid order: each publication on it, with its own stage, what we need next, the content the client sent, the latest outline or draft we wrote, and a sample of the publication's writing. Each publication is worked through separately. Needs the client's private order link, which only they have; a wrong or revoked link reads like a missing order.

orderLink.description: The client's private order link (https://theprofound.agency/order/<id>/#t=…), or just the token after #t=. It is the "Open your order page" button in the order confirmation email sent when the order is paid.

name: get_client_order
title: See where a client's article is
